searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase two — critique and improvements the awtsmoos gives gevurah to guard the work from its own ambition; awtsmoos.com improves when breadth never becomes blindness. improvements 1. do not equate html file count with public route count; classify fixtures/templates first. 2. do not wait on full git status before route discovery; keep a lighter census lane. 3. do not rewrite actively claimed routes even when screenshots look terrible. 4. use prior agent outputs as evidence but refresh critical claims from current files/runtime. 5. finish sefarim tests before using it as a design precedent. 6. browser test sefarim because source/test green still cannot prove layout. 7. avoid generic lighthouse like scores as the sole performance gate; collect actionable timing/resource evidence. 8. measure interactive readiness for games/editors, not only domcontentloaded. 9. separate site owned console errors from browser extensions/noise. 10. treat 404s for intentional optional resources differently from broken required assets. 11. detect page level horizontal overflow and internal intentional scrollers separately. 12. check 200% zoom on representative interactive families. 13. prefer native disclosure/buttons/forms over custom js controls when semantics allow. 14. preserve route local visual identity; coherence should come from interaction quality, not identical styling. 15. avoid adding new dependencies for cosmetic fixes. 16. version changed static assets when the current cache model requires query versions. 17. inspect compact server implementation before adding query params to assets. 18. compare compact response latency as well as bytes; cpu heavy transforms can make small files slower. 19. check caching/content encoding before merging css modules just to reduce request count. 20. keep tests about user visible invariants, not obsolete dom implementation trivia. 21. add regression contracts only after the first implementation draft for each route. 22. rerun scoped status immediately before each production write. 23. record route owner/claim evidence in the ledger. 24. use sitewide reruns between tranches to catch regressions early. 25. do not publish until secret/large file/risk checks pass. 26. push all safe requested unrelated changes, but never knowingly publish credentials or machine local secrets. 27. separate github push from production deploy and verify both independently. 28. post deploy smoke both normal and compact/cache paths where used. revised strategy a measured rolling reconstruction: discover → classify → rank → claim safe family → full file rewrite → reread → family tests → browser → performance → global rerun → repeat. github/deploy only after the sitewide ledger reaches a release safe state. next action write the improved phase two execution plan, then a final phase three critique with at least thirty additional safeguards.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase two — improved execution plan the awtsmoos creates every route in its moment; awtsmoos.com should improve by a rhythm that is broad in scope and exact in evidence. work graph census → classify public vs fixture → audit live routes → merge runtime findings with active ownership → rank → repair clean family → reread → tests → browser → performance → rerun full audit → next family. evidence ledger fields route, source entry, family, owner/claim, current git status, load status, console errors, failed resources, overflow, focus/labels/touch findings, visual hierarchy notes, performance timings, planned files, actual files, tests, browser proof, remaining delta. mutation doctrine full file rewrites only. split any touched source 120 lines rather than compressing. tabs in indented touched source. preserve/expand comments rather than deleting them for line count. no global stylesheet changes until repeated root cause evidence exists. no minified repository source. verification rhythm family level focused tests first; live browser second; performance third; sitewide regression rerun fourth. a route is not complete until all relevant gates pass. performance rhythm cold navigation, warm navigation, request/transfer inventory, blocking resources, long tasks/interactive readiness, cache headers/content encoding, compact vs normal benchmark where supported. release rhythm secret scan → large/generated review → fetch/topology → full safe staging → commit → refresh concurrent delta → follow up commit if needed → push → verify remote sha → actual deploy → production smoke → production performance → final delta push. next action perform the phase three critique, freeze the exact next execution tranche, then harvest running tests/census/audit jobs and begin route ranking.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase three — final safeguards before sitewide execution the awtsmoos is beyond the ledger yet gives the ledger truth; awtsmoos.com must survive the skeptical user, maintainer, tester, and future youth. additional safeguards 1. verify every counted route is actually navigable. 2. preserve canonical url semantics and trailing slash behavior. 3. check redirects separately from load failures. 4. detect html served for missing js/css as mime/catch all defects. 5. distinguish auth required from broken unauthenticated pages. 6. record browser viewport/device scale used for each layout check. 7. check scroll height and fixed overlays on short screens. 8. check touch target size for primary actions. 9. check focus visibility after any outline customization. 10. check logical focus order after dom rearrangement. 11. check native form submit/enter behavior. 12. check back/forward/reload state for search/social flows. 13. check reduced motion when animated pages claim motion. 14. check high content/long title resilience. 15. check hebrew/rtl content where relevant without forcing global rtl. 16. check empty/loading/error/success/disabled/selected states. 17. check offline/network failure behavior where realistic. 18. check local storage/history corruption tolerance where used. 19. check game pause/restart after focus loss. 20. check editor resize and canvas dpr behavior. 21. check media autoplay policy assumptions. 22. check route indexes do not advertise dead experiences as complete. 23. check broken external links separately from local runtime. 24. check source maps/debug assets do not block production. 25. check large images/video do not become critical path resources without need. 26. check font loading does not cause avoidable invisible text. 27. check compact output syntax and mime for es modules. 28. check compact transform cache key includes relevant query/version inputs. 29. check noncompact fallback remains functional. 30. check cold start server transform cost. 31. check route level css duplication before any consolidation decision. 32. check shared component changes against multiple representative routes. 33. check each new module has one real responsibility. 34. check every changed import path actually resolves on case sensitive filesystems. 35. check line endings/encoding preserve hebrew text correctly. 36. check tests fail for the regression they claim to protect. 37. check no test was weakened merely to achieve green. 38. check full git snapshot for secrets before staging/push. 39. check oversized binaries/generated artifacts before publication. 40. check upstream divergence after fetch. 41. check deployment uses the pushed commit. 42. check production normal cache and cache busted behavior. 43. check production error logs/health where available. 44. check representative routes after deploy, not only the edited one. 45. reopen the remaining work ledger after every success; success creates shadow work. next action write the final execution tranche, then harvest every currently running discovery/verification receipt and execute the first safe ranked route family.
